title: Michael Don't Leave Me Here
blurb: Underneath the jump scares, Five Nights at Freddy's is a story about a family, and this is one of the lines where the mask slips. Screamed rather than spoken, it carries real desperation — the kind the series usually hides behind animatronics and static. Fans who have followed the lore know exactly what it costs; everyone else simply hears somebody being abandoned. Play it theatrically when a friend leaves a Discord call without warning, or entirely sincerely if you are one of the people who actually understands the timeline.
origin: A line from Five Nights at Freddy's lore, adopted by the fandom.
